title: COMMISSION_CHARGE_STATUS_CHANGED
description: A commission charge changed status (confirmed, disputed, dispute rejected). Kiorex mirrors it as a claim, idempotently and in time order (an event older than the newest applied one is ignored). The Clinic stays the system of record for the charge and the decision; Kiorex's collection ledger follows this event. Additive in 1.13.0 (the Clinic has emitted it since COM-1).

decisionRef.description: Id of the Kiorex AttributionDecision (or the Clinic CommissionDecision) that explains the outcome. Additive in 1.10.0.

origin.description: Commission-relevant acquisition origin decided by the Kiorex attribution function (additive in 1.10.0). Absent = UNATTRIBUTED and today's rules apply.

policyVersion.description: Version id of the ATTRIBUTION_POLICY config that was ACTIVE at decision time. Additive in 1.10.0.

feeBasisMinor.description: Fee the Kiorex fee was computed on, before any sponsored discount (additive, 1.12.0; policy SPONSORED_PROMOTION_POLICY.commissionBasis).

sponsoredDiscountMinor.description: Provider-sponsored discount on the booking, informational (additive, 1.12.0).

basisPolicyVersion.description: Version id of the policy that fixed the basis (additive, 1.12.0).

tenantId.description: Organisation (Clinic tenant) that owns the charge; the reference Kiorex collects against (additive, 1.13.0).

decisionAmount.description: Amount the append-only commission decision states, decimal string 2 dp; a charge whose amount differs is a reconciliation finding (additive, 1.13.0).

disputeDeadline.description: End of the provider's dispute window (additive, 1.13.0).

disputeStatus.description: Status of the charge's dispute, null when there is none (additive, 1.13.0).

confirmedAt.description: When the charge was confirmed; null while it is not.

aggregateType.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.

aggregateId.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.
